name: Shinnok's Netherrealm forces invade Earthrealm
description: After the MK9 conflict, Shinnok escapes his prior confinement and attacks a weakened Earthrealm with Netherrealm forces. Quan Chi and corrupted Earthrealm warriors operate as part of the offensive. This Event establishes the invasion occurrence but does not manufacture a causal edge to every later battle that happens during the wider campaign.
